rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard DFT techniques (PBE, HSE, Berry-phase polarization) on a specific 2D material. The concepts are non-trivial (stacking-dependent symmetry, piezoelectric tensor calculation) but well-documented. No novel algorithm is required; the main difficulty is correctly translating the paper’s geometry and workflow into a series of QE calculations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has multiple stages: constructing monolayer, bilayer, trilayer structures, relaxing each, computing band structures with two functionals, applying strain and re-relaxing, and running polarization calculations for multiple layers and strain points. The agent must manage QE input generation, job submission, convergence, and output parsing. While scriptable, the orchestration of ~10+ individual DFT runs with dependencies makes this a complex engineering task.
